description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-calendars-client/src/methods/principal_availability.rs implementing principal_get_availability on SessionClient. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §2.2.

**Signature:**
pub async fn principal_get_availability(&self, principal_id: &str, utc_start: &str, utc_end: &str, show_details: Option<bool>, event_properties: Option<&[&str]>) -> Result<PrincipalGetAvailabilityResponse, ClientError>

**Algorithm:**
1. Create principal_availability.rs and add pub mod principal_availability to mod.rs.
2. Guards: principal_id.is_empty() → InvalidArgument; utc_start.is_empty() → InvalidArgument; utc_end.is_empty() → InvalidArgument.
3. session_parts() → (api_url, account_id).
4. Build args: accountId, id (NOT principalId — spec §2.2 uses "id"), utcStart, utcEnd; conditionally add showDetails and eventProperties.
5. build_request("Principal/getAvailability", args, USING_AVAILABILITY).
6. call_internal → extract_response.
7. Unit tests: empty principal_id → InvalidArgument; request uses "id" key (not "principalId"); show_details:None → absent from request; using contains principals:availability URI.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- principal_id:"" returns Err(InvalidArgument).
- Request uses "id" key per spec §2.2 (NOT "principalId").
- using contains "urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals:availability".
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-client exits 0.
title: Implement principal_get_availability method on SessionClient (§2.2)
